headline_real: ILLENIUM Turns Sphere Into a 'Neo-Space Opera' With Nine-Night ODYSSEY Residency
facts: Nine shows across March 5-7, 12-14 and April 2-4, 2026 — only the second electronic act at Sphere after Anyma
Berlin's Woodblock Animation Studios built the narrative with 65 animators working in Houdini
Content mapped to Sphere's 160,000-square-foot wraparound interior LED screen
Visuals follow a two-warrior light-vs-dark story tied to his album ODYSSEY (out Feb 6, 2026, Republic Records)

headline_real: Tomorrowland Unveils 'Consciencia,' Its Most Ambitious Mainstage Ever
facts: Stage stands 43 metres tall and 140 metres wide, centered on a sculpted face named Amutaz
Built from 2,400 LED tiles, 1,200 lighting fixtures (300 custom), 56 lasers, 38 fountains, 2 waterfalls and 7 giant inflatable faces
Took over two years from first sketch to opening night, plus 54 days of on-site construction
Theme spans six 'provinces,' each mapped to a human emotion — wonder, joy, desire, love, anger, sadness

headline_real: Soda Stereo Take a Touring Digital Frontman on the Road With the ECOS Tour
facts: A hyperrealistic digital avatar of late singer Gustavo Cerati (d. 2014) performs live alongside surviving members Zeta Bosio and Charly Alberti
Uses hyperrealistic renderings plus archival audio rather than AI-generated movement or synthetic vocals, unlike fixed installs such as ABBA Voyage
Fully modular and touring — 14 countries, nearly two dozen cities, 450,000-plus tickets sold, with a September U.S. leg (San Jose, LA, Las Vegas, Chicago, NY, Miami)
Creative-directed by Nicolas Bernaudo, with roughly two-hour shows

headline_real: Cleveland Museum of Art opens 'ArtLens Reimagined,' a gallery driven by locally-run AI trained only on its own collection
facts: Opened July 28, 2026 as a 10,000-square-foot space with 21 new interactive experiences
Uses locally-run AI models trained exclusively on the museum's own collection; 'Infinite Landscape' generates AI scenery on a 24-foot curved wall

Organized into five themed zones - Relate, Investigate, Create, Explore and Infinite Landscape, with Chief Digital Innovation officer Jane Alexander framing tech as 'the bridge that helps people engage more deeply'
